dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge forming a sickle-shaped curve from the distal apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow-radius rounded tip at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steep slope of approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.15:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent triangular patch of parallel linear rake marks located on the mid-posterior flank; several small, white circular lesions and thin linear scratches are visible on the mid-body.
other_distinctive_markers: Single distinct notch on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin located approximately one-third of the distance from the posterior base to the apex.
